content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
FfcWebShellProbability
0 - 100 value based on gathered statistics that represents the % probability the file is a webshell.
FfcPatternsTotalScore
The calculated final accumulated score based on the total hits from all regexes.
FfcPatternsTotalHits
The total number of hits for all regexes against the file content.
FfcPatternWithMostHits The regex string that hit the most number of times in the file content.
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
ForensicsText
A unit of forensically intersting text read from a system logor some other text file of interest, such as shell history, ssh config, startup
scripts, etc.
